title: Final Probability Distribution
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct probability distribution for the number of red bacteria after a long time.

title: Time Estimate
description: Essential Criteria: The student must estimate the time required for the probability distribution to stabilize, indicating 6 to 7 hours.

title: Effect of Predator Preference
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly describe how a 1% preference for red bacteria affects the probability distribution and time estimate.

title: Mathematical Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear mathematical justification for the probability distribution derived in part (a).

title: Understanding of Population Dynamics
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate an understanding of the population dynamics involved in the predator-prey relationship.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the probabilities or misunderstanding the predator's effect.

title: Clarification of Variables
description: Optional Criteria: The student should clarify the meaning of variables used in their equations for better understanding.
